executive_summary.context: Five suppliers (IP Sun, Porton, Huizhou BYD Electronic, Smoore, EVE Energy) moved from HIGH back to MEDIUM risk as the initial geopolitical signal was downgraded; the overall board shifted from RED to AMBER 29 hours ago when the Suppliers pillar cleared and the World pillar became the only driver. The Strait of Hormuz transits are down 97% year-on-year, the Rhine is critically low at two key gauges, and Brent crude and EU gas prices remain severely elevated—these are the active constraints now…
